method: Read-only interactive Chrome inspection of public pages, DOM, and embedded Product JSON-LD; no account sign-in, cart submission, or purchase.
scope: 30 unique rendered page URLs, including 21 product pages. Robots.txt is additional. XML sitemap access attempts are not counted as inspected pages.
offer_encoding: Each pair is [source ordering quantity, total price in dollars] from Product.offers. Ordering quantity may mean tablets, capsules, boxes, bottles, or packs. C62 alone does not resolve the physical unit. The quantity-1 offer on loose-unit products was not validated as a purchasable single-unit fill.
availability: All 21 sampled Product JSON-LD records and visible product status indicated In Stock. Out-of-stock behavior was not observed.

records.finding: Search, featured quantity-specific links, and category entry points. Featured Lisinopril 180-tablet price per pill was 0.09; its product page later displayed 0.10.
649 anchor elements observed, including duplicate/footer links. Nested category trees cover prescription, pet, insulin, supplies, and product families. Category counts are not unique product counts.

records.finding: Published free shipping on prescription orders and OTC orders over 15 USD; paid options 5/10/15/25 USD. Cold-chain uses Next Day Air Monday–Thursday; final cold-chain cost not established. Processing 1–5 business days in addition to transit.
Published use license is personal/non-commercial/transitory and restricts copying, public display, and mirroring. Production reuse remains a legal question, not resolved by this technical inspection.
Expandable FAQ UI; website pricing and no membership fee. Full FAQ insurance and manufacturer-coupon answers were not interactively expanded in this pass.

Search input navigated to /search/metformin; 27 results included combination medicines and ER products. After client navigation from FAQ, canonical still pointed to /faqs in captured DOM; do not trust generic canonical metadata for discovery identity.
